integration.minimal_hook: decode_timeline(..., *, feature_state_overrides=None): use only validated recovered state map by feature ID, otherwise existing feature_state(body). Default path/output exact.
integration.placement: Call after decode_assembly and preferably after existing decode_component_creation (move that call before timeline or reuse summary later). No dependency decoder required.
integration.aliases: Attach separately by (history_record_object_id,native_history_entry_object_id) to timeline visible entries, preserving native IDs, feature kinds, raw order and groups. Add occurrence entity metadata; do not rename UnsupportedFeature as a decoded modeling feature.
integration.snapshot_visibility: No filtering of snapshot classes: assembly snapshot260 is native history entry for occurrence creation while related CreateComponent254 is absent. Hidden/non-history internal creation/snapshot records remain separate.
integration.existing_successes: Batch helper skips footers already accepted by old reader; six canonical timeline controls remain no-ops.

limitations: New variant flags are all false in saved assembly variants; positive suppression/rollback semantics derive from independently controlled canonical footer contrasts, not new active variant captures.
Does not establish health/error state, unknown scalar or stored integer meaning, group assignment from final links, timeline replay or historical/current solved assembly transforms.
Occurrence API display prefixes/whitespace are not encoded by these aliases; compare entity names separately. Unnamed component implicit display names stay None.
CopyPaste occurrence identity uses its separate existing provenance helper; not synthesized from list position or names.
No UI/Fusion calls, no captures or shared edits.
